origin.description: Deduces the URLs of the Bioconductor repositories.

arguments.name: r_ver
arguments.text: R version to use. Ignored when bioc_ver is supplied.

arguments.name: bioc_ver
arguments.text: Bioconductor version to use. Defaults to the version corresponding to r_ver.

origin.details: Observes R_BIOC_VERSION when bioc_ver is omitted. Observes R_BIOC_MIRROR and the BioC_mirror option. The option takes precedence. The default mirror is https://bioconductor.org. BioCworkflows is included when the Bioconductor version is at least 3.7, BioCextra when it is at most 3.5, and BioCbooks when it is at least 3.12.
origin.value: A named character vector of repository URLs.

translation.description: Deduces the URLs of the Bioconductor repositories.

arguments.name: r_ver
arguments.text: R version string. Used only when bioc_ver is omitted. None uses the installed R version.

arguments.name: bioc_ver
arguments.text: Bioconductor version string. None calls bioc_version(r_ver). The string auto looks up the current R version.

translation.details: The mirror is R_BIOC_MIRROR, or https://bioconductor.org when that variable is unset. A BioC_mirror entry in bioc.options wins. Versions compare as numeric components, so 3.12 is greater than 3.7. BioCworkflows is included when the version is at least 3.7, BioCextra when it is at most 3.5, and BioCbooks when it is at least 3.12. A false test is omitted, so Bioc 3.6 has soft, annotation, and experiment.
translation.value: An ordered list of (name, url) pairs.
